content.what_it_is: Commented tutorial variant of plot_bathy.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD inlet_shoal simple case, with a marked 'User Input' section (L4-L13) setting fdir='../bathy/' (L9). Loads dep.out from fdir (L16) — unlike plot_bathy.m which loads dep_shoal_inlet.txt — derives n,m by size (L17), builds x,y with dx=dy=2.0 (L20-L23), defines sponge rectangle x 0-180 m (L26-L27) and wavemaker rectangle x 240-260 m (L30-L31) each spanning full y, configures a 5x6 inch figure (L34-L36), plots pcolor(x,y,-dep) shading flat (L40), colorbar labeled '-dep (m)' (L42-L43), overlays sponge (green dashed, 'Sponge' text; L48-L49) and wavemaker (white, 'Wavemaker' text; L50-L51) between hold on/off (L47, L52), sets caxis([-10 3]) and labels (L54-L56), and prints inlet_shoal.jpg (L59). Every step carries an explanatory comment (L1, L8, L15, L19, L25, L29, L33, L39, L45-L46, L58).
entities: n and m from size(dep) L17
unresolved: this commented variant loads dep.out (L16) while the sibling plot_bathy.m loads dep_shoal_inlet.txt; which filename actually exists under ../bathy/ is not determinable from this file
fdir assignment at L9 lacks a trailing semicolon so it echoes to the console; whether intentional (tutorial display) is not stated
